reason: The runbook uses the exact four required headings in order, explicitly gates any data-risking action (including failover) behind a verified snapshot, includes clear abort/rollback conditions, and ends with the correct SECTIONS line, while also addressing non-obvious operational nuances like growth-rate alerting, crash- vs application-consistent snapshots, and replication lag/RPO risk on failover.
